configuration.turnImeOffWhenSelectionSta: Turn IME Off When a Selection Starts
On Windows, turns the IME off when a keyboard or mouse selection starts, so function-key commands such as F8 reach VS Code. Disable this if you want to keep the IME on while selecting text.
